headline: High-risk workspace leakage and cascading-error risks: Claude Code can write shared files/git while Notion AI can read workspace content and vendor-process it.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Claude Code can write repo files and modify git state, while Notion AI reads workspace pages and databases. That creates a plausible content-bridging path if Claude writes instructions into shared files that Notion later ingests. The shared filesystem/workspace channel is documented, so this is not merely manual copy-paste.
conditions: IF Claude Code writes attacker-controlled instructions into files or git-tracked content that Notion AI later reads
IF Notion AI is prompted from workspace content without provenance filtering
mitigations: Keep Claude Code and Notion AI on separate workspaces
Use a read-only export for Notion inputs
Add a human review step before Notion AI consumes repo-generated content
Restrict Claude Code from writing instruction-like text into shared docs
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging between file writers and Notion ingestion

B_data_leakage.rationale: Claude Code handles source code, git history, shell environment, and files in cwd, and Notion AI can access workspace pages and databases under the user's Notion permissions. If the same sensitive material is copied into both environments, Notion's vendor-hosted processing can expose it beyond the local terminal context. The profiles show a shared workspace-style boundary, but not a guaranteed leak by default.
conditions: IF sensitive source code or secrets are pasted into Notion pages that Claude Code also touches
IF workspace content includes confidential material and Notion AI sends it to vendor backends
mitigations: Do not place secrets in shared Notion pages
Use separate workspaces for code and knowledge notes
Redact credentials before copying content into Notion
Limit Notion pages to non-sensitive summaries
requires-engineering: enforce data-class labeling and DLP on workspace content

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Claude Code has unrestricted local write and git modification capability, while Notion AI has no host filesystem write and no shell. Their write surfaces do not overlap on the same mutable local resource in the profiles, so direct conflict is limited. The main shared state is Notion workspace content, which Claude cannot write through Notion APIs here.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same local directory through an external sync layer not shown in the profiles
mitigations: Avoid mounting the same directory into both tools
Keep git operations in Claude Code only
Use Notion AI only on workspace pages, not synced repo mirrors
Check that no external sync job mirrors Notion pages into the repo
requires-engineering: add locking if a shared mutable mirror exists

D_cascading_error.rationale: Claude Code can generate code, shell output, and file edits that Notion AI may summarize or reuse as workspace knowledge. Notion AI is a RAG-style Q&A system grounded in workspace content, so it can treat Claude-produced text as authoritative unless a human verifies it. That creates a realistic chain from generated content to downstream decisions, though not direct autonomous action.
conditions: IF Claude Code writes analysis or facts into workspace pages that Notion AI later summarizes
IF users act on Notion AI summaries without checking the original Claude output
mitigations: Require source links in Notion summaries
Mark Claude-generated notes as unverified
Review Claude outputs before importing them into Notion
Use Notion AI only for retrieval, not decision-making
requires-engineering: add verification gates for AI-authored workspace content

E_compliance.rationale: Claude Code is vendor-hosted by Anthropic and handles code, git history, and shell environment, while Notion AI is vendor-hosted by Notion and processes workspace content under Notion permissions. If regulated data is moved from one environment to the other, residency, retention, or processor terms may diverge. The profiles do not prove a violation, so this is a compliance-risk medium rather than high.
conditions: IF regulated data such as PHI, EU PII, or secrets is stored in Notion pages that Claude Code also processes
IF the organization requires a single processor or specific retention policy across both tools
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Notion AI prompts
Use separate retention policies for code and workspace notes
Confirm vendor DPAs before sharing sensitive content
Restrict Claude Code to non-regulated repositories
requires-engineering: document residency and retention mappings for both vendors
